study_identification_part.si_4_title: Lifespan Normative Models of White Matter Fractional Anisotropy: Applications to Early Psychosis

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Warped Bayesian linear regression (BLR) with a third-order polynomial B-spline basis expansion over age and SinhArcsinh warping.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We then fit lifespan normative models to these data on the basis of age, sex, site and race using warped Bayesian linear regression (BLR) and a non-linear basis expansion over age... we employed a warped Bayesian linear regression (BLR) model... This approach involved applying a third-order polynomial B-spline basis expansion over age... combined with a SinhArcsinh warping function.
